notes.title: Patch 0.8010 Leaderboard and QOL
notes.notes:
-0.8010-

-Changes-
> Card Mana color for sprites is default slot 1 is blue, slot 2 is red, slot 3 is green and slot 4 is yellow - this way your card mana sprite identifies easily which deck the card belongs to
> First Time Loaders of this game wont have audio maxed out everything will be set to 50%
> Guild Master - Twist of Fate changed -> Discard all cards in hand and for each deck you control where the unit is alive draw cards evenly from them until your hand is full.
> Holding 9 cards renders better in particular with larger party sizes

-Bug Fixes-
>Mac - Cursor Should be fixed on Mac machines users mentioned this was too large
Changes
> Events can be combats again so Lantern isn't useless
>Speed of Run Leaderboard actually functions for both the Demo and Main Game now - the posting of this was based on a boolean Player Defeated this was not a good flag to set this to, instead picked node level because that always increments on boss kill so this correctly behaves in the fact you can only get a score for it if you have won the game
>Flexibility Card not working Guild Master

notes.title: Little Adventure Tale Full Game release!
notes.notes:
Hey Gamer's after ages I've finally finished my game Inspired by Slay the Spire! 
I'm a solo developer that works full time so I'm very happy to get something out, though I do acknowledge its not perfect.

In the next coming days I will make updates to the Store Page with an updated trailer and maybe some new GIFS!

I need to increase the Stat counters as well there is well over 280 cards for example. I fell short on some things like Events but might have to revisit that later. The game is likely not perfect I will be working to address any bugs you might find please do reach out.

The important parts are there though I'm excited for you to try the two new Player Classes!

5 Player Classes:
> Knight
> Rogue
> Mage
> Paladin
> Guild Master

9 Non-Player Classes:
> Cleric
> Witch Doctor
> Witch Hunter
> Ranger
> K9
> Shield Seer
> Artificer
> Shaman
> Druid

== 0.8001 ==

- Changes -
> Fixed Reprisal Card for Paladin
> Fix Card Text

== 0.8000 ==

- Changes -
> Improved Ascension Display
> Language Menu easier to access on start screen
> Finished Paladin Class
> Finished Guild Master Class
> Localization Updates

Thank you and have a good weekend!
